calibration.rule: threshold: 95% of unknown pills rejected; margin: largest with own-pill flip requests <= 10%

training_coverage: Loose-pill photos of US prescription pills (NLM C3PI): 2,362 medicines; catalogue of 4,936 US pill products. Not trained on Singapore products, packaging or blisters.
known_limits: Other phones and lighting: 48% top-1 over 32 Hong Kong products (MEDISEG), against 83% on held-out C3PI.
Similarities are not probabilities: pills that aren't in the catalogue still score about 0.93 median.
Imprints are readable on about 38% of photos.
The stand-in pill finder works on plain backgrounds only; check count_reliable before counting pills.
Visual evidence only: never confirms the medicine, its strength, or that it is safe to take.
